verdict.rationale: Factory's Droid is operated by delegating tasks in plain language. The bash-mode toggle runs shell commands 'without AI interpretation,' which implies default input is interpreted by the AI. Users can also mention @Factory in Linear or Jira comments to have Droid implement work, and design mode lets users say what to change. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement describing natural-language command input, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Press ! to toggle bash mode and run shell commands directly without AI interpretation.
mention `@Factory` in an issue comment to have Droid investigate, implement, and test the work.
Design mode selects an element and says what to change; inline code review comments on a diff line by line. Droid acts on the feedback in place.
Delegate a task, review the diff, and merge from the App or your terminal.
